name: WANTED: Bruuz
label: Quest
description: WANTED: Bruuz is a bounty posted by Gazlowe in the goblin port of Ratchet. A massive predatory shark has taken up residence near the harbor docks…
intro: WANTED: Bruuz is a bounty posted by Gazlowe in the goblin port of Ratchet. A massive predatory shark has taken up residence near the harbor docks, threatening maritime traffic and coastal trade until someone puts an end to it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

clips.title: Progress
paras: What can I do for ya, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!" all the time?
I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
